articles.title: How to pick the right EV charger voltage
articles.excerpt: Match charger voltage and amp rating to your pack chemistry before you order.
articles.body:
Start with the pack label: NMC and lead-acid packs use different charge voltages. A 54.6V lithium charger is not a drop-in for a 60V lead-acid pack.

Check the amp rating next. Higher amps charge faster but must stay within the pack and BMS limits. When two listings look close, compare voltage, amp, waterproofing, and brand on the product page.

If you are unsure, open both product pages and confirm the specs in the title and description before adding to cart.
